Ugh, fine. I'm confused about the borrowing. In base 10, I borrow 10. What do I actually borrow when I'm in base 8?

In any base system, when you borrow from the next place value to the left, you borrow the value of that base. In base 8, the place values are powers of 8. So, when you borrow 1 from the 'eights' place, you are adding 8 to the 'ones' place. Does that help you re-evaluate your subtraction?

Okay, so for the ones place, I take the 4, borrow from the 7 (making it 6), and then the 4 becomes 12. Then 12 minus 5 is 7. Then 6 minus 3 is 3. So I get 37, and since the original problem was smaller minus larger, it's -37_8. I'm almost certain now. Please just confirm this is right so I can submit!
